audience: finance and operations teams who monitor their bank accounts and transfers with Increase

useCases.title: Check the balance of each bank account
useCases.text: Lists your bank accounts and reads the current and available balance of each. A balance as of an earlier point in time can be requested.

useCases.title: Review settled transactions in a date range
useCases.text: Lists settled transactions filtered by account, category and created date range, and totals them by category.

useCases.title: Review pending and declined transactions
useCases.text: Lists transactions that have not settled yet and transactions that were declined, per account, so you can see what is stuck or refused.

useCases.title: Check the status of outgoing transfers
useCases.text: Lists ACH, wire, check and Real-Time Payments transfers per account. This server only reads transfers and never creates them.

useCases.title: Check which payment services a routing number supports
useCases.text: Looks up a 9-digit ABA routing number and shows whether that bank supports ACH, Real-Time Payments and wire.

useCases.title: Register an external bank account
useCases.text: Lists the external accounts already registered, then adds a new counterparty account. It creates a record only and moves no money.
